When microphone transcription fails, verify the selected capture device and actual STT provider separately from the chat model.

Compact voice presentation uses green/white for user speech and blue/white for assistant activity, while transcript and answer text remain visible nearby.

component=micro-model; files=docs/adr/ADR-0001-micro-model-candidate-benchmark.md,docs/MICRO_MODEL_BENCHMARK.md. Qwen3-0.6B Q4_0 and SmolLM2-360M Q8_0 failed the quality/memory gate. component=startup-crash; file=docs/PROJECT_HANDBOOK.md. Windows exception code 0xe0434352 is only a wrapper for an unhandled .NET exception. Diagnose from the startup/fatal report and inner exception. A prior first-window crash was fixed by explicit OneWay bindings for read-only diagnostic fields.

component=release; file=eng/build.ps1. The full release gate is eng/build.ps1 -Configuration Release -Runtime win-x64 and covers build, tests, knowledge/benchmark validation, WPF smoke, snapshots and portable packaging. Start with narrow tests and use the full gate only for cross-cutting or release-ready changes.
